Welcome to our featured artwork page! Here you will find a curated selection of exceptional artworks pertaining to the Wheel of Time series. Our featured artworks will be displayed on the [[A beginning|Wiki Main Page]] and will rotate daily, these will highlight the incredible talent of artists all over the world.

==Guidelines for Featured Artwork:==
* Selection: Featured artworks are chosen based on their quality, relevance, and visual impact.
* Variety: We aim to showcase a diverse range of artistic styles and interpretations.
* Compliance: All artworks featured here are sourced from reputable sources and comply with copyright laws.
* Attribution: Proper credit is given to the artists for their creations.

==Criteria for Selection:==
* Quality: Featured artworks should demonstrate high artistic skill and craftsmanship.
* Relevance: Artworks should depict characters, scenes, or themes from the Wheel of Time series.
* Visual Impact: We prioritize artworks that captivate viewers and convey the essence of the series.
* Diversity: We seek out artworks that offer a variety of perspectives and interpretations.
